title.en: Streamlining the Accreditation System for Donee Institutions and Designating the Department of Social Welfare and Development as the Sole Accrediting Entity for Social Welfare and Development Agencies, Amending Executive Order No. 720 (S. 2008) for the Purpose

text.en:
DSWD as the Accrediting Entity for SWDAs. The DSWD is hereby designated as the sole
accrediting entity for SWDAs.
For Purpose of this Order, an SWDA refers to a non-stock, non-profit corporation, organization, or association
engaged in providing, directly or indirectly, social welfare and development programs and services, and
obtains its finances, either totally or in part, from the community by direct or indirect solicitations and other
fund generating activities, as authorized by law. SWDAs shall be deemed to cover both public and private
SWDAs, including auxiliary SWDAs.

DSWD Accreditation. The Certificate of Registration and Certificate of Accreditation issued by
the DSWD to SWDAs, as applicable, shall be deemed sufficient and shall be recognized by the BIR in
granting donee-institution status for purposes of Sections 34(H) and 101(A) of the NIRC, as amended.

Implementing Rules and Regulations. The Department of Finance, through the BIR, and the
DSWD are hereby directed, consistent with their respective mandates, to issue the necessary rules and
regulations to ensure the effective implementation of this Order.

Transitory Provision. All SWDAs that have been granted donee-institution status prior to the
issuance of this Order shall retain such status until the expiration of their respective Certificates of
Registration and/or Certificates of Accreditation. Upon expiration, the concerned SWDAs shall apply for
accreditation with the DSWD in accordance with this Order and the implementing rules and regulations issued
pursuant hereto.

Repeal. EO No. 720 (s.2008) and all other orders, rules and regulations, issuances, or any part
thereof inconsistent with the provisions of this order are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.
Separability. If any part or provisions not affected shall continue to be in full force and effect.

Effectivity. This order shall take effect immediately upon its publication in the Official Gazette
or a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 7th day of May, in the year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty-Six.
(Sgd.) FERDINAND R. MARCOS, JR.
By the President:
(Sgd.) RALPH G. RECTO
Acting Executive Secretary
